subject.title: Feature request: configurable lane wait diagnostic threshold

question: Should OpenClaw adopt the global `diagnostics.laneWaitWarnMs` configuration surface proposed by the linked PR, or keep lane-wait tuning limited to internal per-call overrides?
rationale: The source-level need is well established, but repository policy sets a high bar for every new configuration key and the issue retains an explicit product-decision signal.

options.title: Sponsor the global setting
options.body: Approve the narrow field with the unchanged 2,000 ms default, positive validation, runtime-snapshot behavior, explicit-override precedence, and public diagnostics documentation.

options.title: Use owner-specific thresholds
options.body: Decline a global configuration key and tune only known queue callers, accepting that operators cannot set one environment-wide warning threshold.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the global setting
recommendation.body: Approve the narrow field with the unchanged 2,000 ms default, positive validation, runtime-snapshot behavior, explicit-override precedence, and public diagnostics documentation.

likelyOwner.reason: The queue history and detailed issue review make steipete the strongest available owner for this config-versus-internal-policy choice.
